name: Gorgias
oneLiner: Ecommerce helpdesk and AI Agent platform built around Shopify order data, covering email, chat, social, SMS and voice.
bestFor: Online stores and DTC brands on Shopify, including food and beverage brands that sell online.

updates.text: Introduced Shopping Assistant, an AI pre-sales feature that recommends products, suggests upsells and can offer discounts inside chat (labeled beta at launch).
Public roadmap calls 2026 the year of AI Agent maturity: stronger knowledge control, deterministic variables and faster responses on a new architecture.

features: Shared inbox for email, chat, social, SMS and voice
Order view and actions (edit, refund, cancel) inside the ticket via Shopify
AI Agent that resolves common questions such as order status and returns
Shopping Assistant for product recommendations in chat
Macros and rules for automated replies and routing
Gorgias Voice with IVR, routing and AI call summaries
Revenue statistics tying support conversations to sales

pricing.text: Helpdesk plans by ticket volume, never priced per agent: Starter $10 per month (monthly billing only, 50 tickets, 3 user seats); Basic $50 per month billed annually or $60 monthly (300 tickets); Pro $300 billed annually or $360 monthly (2,000 tickets); Advanced $750 billed annually or $900 monthly (5,000 tickets); custom plans above 5,000 conversations a month. Overage $0.40 per ticket on Starter and Basic, $0.36 on Pro and Advanced. AI Agent $0.90 per automated interaction on annual plans, $1.00 on monthly plans, and each one also counts as a helpdesk ticket. Voice and SMS are add-ons priced by volume. 7-day free trial, no credit card.

Priced by ticket volume, never per agent; Basic and above include up to 500 user seats

AI Agent is billed only when it resolves a conversation

cons.text: Built for ecommerce and Shopify stores, so a restaurant without an online shop uses little of the order tooling
Ticket-based billing with overages: $0.40 per extra ticket on Starter and Basic, $0.36 on Pro and Advanced
AI Agent costs $0.90 to $1.00 per automated interaction, and each one also counts as a billable helpdesk ticket
Revenue attribution is only on Pro and Advanced
Voice and SMS are paid add-ons, and Starter doesn't offer them
